name: simclock
description: Stream Deck clock showing PC time, real Zulu, or Microsoft Flight Simulator time.

scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.acms.simclock.sdPlugin --output dist --force
scripts.build:bridge: pyinstaller --noconfirm --onefile --console --name simclock_bridge --add-binary "%LOCALAPPDATA%/Programs/Python/Python312/Lib/site-packages/SimConnect/SimConnect.dll;SimConnect" --hidden-import SimConnect --distpath com.acms.simclock.sdPlugin/bridge --workpath build --specpath build bridge/simclock_bridge.py
